title: Baggallini RFID Journey Crossbody

comparisons.notes: Same Baggallini RFID Journey Crossbody (same product description), in stock, new

writeup: The Baggallini RFID Journey Crossbody is a compact travel crossbody with multiple quick-access pockets for a passport, phone and tickets, built-in RFID blocking and an adjustable, removable strap. It's machine washable. Woot has it new for $34.99, while Luggage Online lists the same bag at $80.
